name: North East Mall
summary: North East Mall is a busy regional shopping center in Hurst featuring department stores, fashion and sports retailers, a multiplex cinema, and a food court. This established mall serves as a popular community destination for the Mid-Cities area of the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex.
demographics: North East Mall attracts a diverse, middle-income demographic primarily from the Mid-Cities area of the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex, including families from Hurst, Bedford, Euless, and surrounding communities. The trade area serves a mix of young families, working professionals, and teenagers, with household incomes ranging from $50,000 to $85,000 annually. Shoppers are drawn to the mall's combination of value-oriented fashion retailers, entertainment options including the multiplex cinema, and convenient food court dining. The center serves as a community gathering place for the northeast Tarrant County market, appealing to budget-conscious consumers seeking variety and convenience in a traditional enclosed mall setting.
description: North East Mall stands as a cornerstone shopping destination in Hurst, Texas, serving the vibrant Mid-Cities region of the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex since its opening. This bustling enclosed regional mall offers a comprehensive retail experience with department store anchors, popular fashion chains, and athletic apparel retailers that cater to the diverse needs of North Texas families. The center's entertainment amenities include a modern multiplex cinema, providing moviegoers with the latest blockbusters and family-friendly films. Shoppers can refuel at the expansive food court, which features a variety of quick-service dining options perfect for busy families and groups of friends. With its convenient location on Melbourne Road and strong community presence reflected in over 13,000 Google reviews, North East Mall has established itself as a reliable shopping and entertainment hub where value meets variety in the heart of Tarrant County.
